Amazon is back at it — and this time they’re not just asking employees to come into the office… they’re tracking it, scoring it, labeling it, and flagging it.

Amazon has rolled out a new internal manager dashboard that tracks how often corporate employees badge into the office, how long they stay, which building they go to, and whether they’re meeting the 5-day return-to-office mandate. Low-time badgers. Zero badgers. Unassigned building badgers. Yes, that’s real.
